title: Beason-Hammon Alabama Taxpayer and Citizen Protection Act (Code of Alabama 1975, Title 31, Chapter 13)
source_id: Ala. Code 1975, tit. 31, ch. 13 (s 31-13-1 et seq.)
verified_how: Loaded s 31-13-1 on the register: breadcrumb 'Code of Alabama Title 31 Chapter 13 Section 31-13-1 Short Title', text 'This chapter shall be known and may be cited as the Beason-Hammon Alabama Taxpayer and Citizen Protection Act.', source credit '(Act 2011-535, p. 888, s 1.)'. The register shows the chapter as part of the Code and does not mark it repealed.
notes: NEEDS A HUMAN CHECK. Immigration and work authorisation are federal (Immigration and Nationality Act, 8 U.S.C.); this state Act reaches employers via E-Verify duties and related sanctions. Several of its provisions were enjoined in federal litigation after 2011 (United States v. Alabama / HICA v. Governor of Alabama, 11th Cir.), and the register carries no annotation of that, so the operative scope of the chapter cannot be established from the register alone.
